name: Valerian Root
indication_description:
Valerian Root is indicated in-
  • Insomnia
  • Anxiety
  • Nervous excitation
  • Muscle spasm and pain
  • Restlessness
  • Migraine
  • Lack of concentration
pharmacology_description: Valerian capsule is a special preparation of standardized extract of Valerian root. Valerian is a perennial herb, ranging from 2-5 feet in height, native to Eurasia and North America. Valerian acts as centrally depressive, sedative, tranquilizer, anxiolytic, antioxidant, spasmolytic, analgesic, anti-inflammatory and muscle relaxant.
dosage_description: 1-2 capsule(s) daily 30 minutes before bed time or as prescribed by the physician.
contraindications_description: Valerian is contraindicated in case of hypersensitivity to the plant.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in therapeutic dosage. Over dosage may cause headache, depression, nausea, lethargy, uneasiness, bradycardia, arrhythmias and decrease intestinal motility.
precautions_description: Valerian should not be administered during pregnancy, lactating mother and children without medical supervision.
storage_conditions_description: Store in a cool and dry place. Protect from sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.
